Comprehensive Exam Reviewer · Mixed set

All POI topics, mixed

Mixed set: 30 Actual Exam questions from all 15 graded exams + 20 exam-style practice questions from rotating no-exam lessons. Unseen questions are selected first within each source/topic; the final order is shuffled. Topics rotate after your first answer so all 27 no-exam lessons are reachable within two consecutive sets. Full set: all 491 Actual Exam questions only. Topic coverage set: 353 exam-style questions covering the 27 topics with no graded exam, all in one sitting. Graded lesson exams: Military Leadership Attributes; Field Artillery Operations; ISR Operations; Signal Support in Combined Arms Operations; Signal Support in Joint Operations; Signal Support in Coalition Operations; Army Operations. Graded module exams also cover Modules 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7 and 8, plus the Diagnostic Examination. Exam-style practice (no graded lesson exam): Military Leadership Competencies; Company Management; Mission Command; Ethical and Transformational Leadership; NCO Empowerment; Effective Communication 2; Armor Operations; Troop Leading Procedure; Military Decision-Making Process; MANET C4ISTAR Planning; C4ISTAR Sensors Integration; C4ISTAR Weapon System Integration; Signal Propagation (Mobile Apps/RF Clouds); Signals Intelligence (SIGINT); Electronic Intelligence (ELINT); Radio Direction Finding; Electronic Counter-Countermeasures (ECCM); NIST Framework; Zero Trust; LOE3 GSOMIA Compliance; Cyber Risk Assessment; CEOI / CESI Management; Signal Estimate; Voice Communications Planning; Data Communications Planning; C4ISTAR Communications Planning; Signal Planning Process. Supporting Lessons are excluded from the exam-style practice. Attempts keep the existing Actual Exam history category; individual exam-style questions are labelled separately.

01

Before you begin

2 to 40 characters. Shown on your results and in the class score history.

These are questions from the class’s graded exams. Each question keeps the exam’s stem and answer key. The portal showed no answer choices, so the other choices are plausible same-topic options; after you answer, an explanation and a reason for each wrong choice appear. Study the complete lessons as well.

02

Choose an attempt

To enable the difficulty buttons, enter your name and check the study confirmation above.

Actual Exam + Exam-style practice Graded exams and exam-style practice

Choose a mixed set, the full Actual Exam bank, or a sweep of every no-exam topic. Exam-style practice uses fixed choices, explanations and references, with unseen-first progress saved on this device. All three sets use the existing Actual Exam score history category; each item is labelled by its source.

03

Records and privacy

No login and no tracking. Your answers stay in this browser tab and are cleared when you refresh or close it. When your instructor has set up the class history, finishing an attempt sends your name, score, percentage, mastery band and finish time to the class history sheet, together with the reference codes of the questions you were asked and of those you missed (for the instructor’s question analysis). The answers you chose are never sent, and practice retries of missed questions are not sent at all. To put questions you have not seen yet first, then those you missed, this browser remembers which questions it has shown you and which were missed (question codes only, no name); that record never leaves this device.
